channel.title: Wartabiye TV
channel.description: Wararka Soomaaliya, Afrika, adduunka iyo ciyaaraha.

item.title: Iran oo beenisay wadahadal la qorsheeyay, kaddib markii Trump sheegay in dagaalka ciidan uu 'ku dhowaad dhammaaday'
item.description: Madaxweyne Donald Trump ayaa sheegay in dagaalka Iran uu dhinaca militariga ka 'ku dhowaad dhammaaday', halka saraakiisha Iran ay beeniyeen warar sheegaya wadahadal la qorsheeyay oo Qatar lagu qabanayo, sida ay werisay Euronews.

item.title: Lix dal iyo shirkado ay ka mid yihiin Anthropic, OpenAI iyo Microsoft oo saxiixay 'Baaqa Paris' ee amniga AI
item.description: Madaxda Bahrain, Canada, Finland, Faransiiska, Norway iyo Netherlands iyo madaxda 10 shirkadood oo AI ah ayaa 9-ka November saxiixay baaq wadajir ah oo loogu magac daray 'Paris Call for AI Safety and Security', sida ay werisay Türkiye Today.

item.title: Madaxweyne Samia oo u ambabaxday Antalya si ay uga qeyb gasho shirka cimilada COP31
item.description: Madaxweynaha Tanzania Samia Suluhu Hassan ayaa u safartay Antalya ee Türkiye si ay uga qeyb gasho shirka COP31 iyo kulan heer sare ah oo ku saabsan cunto-karinta nadiifka ah ee Afrika, sida ay werisay wargeyska dowladda ee Daily News.

item.title: Mandera: 8 qof oo lagu dilay weerar lagu qaaday gaari ilaalinayay shaqaalaha waddada Arabia
item.description: Ugu yaraan 8 qof ayaa lagu dilay weerar gaadmo ah oo hubeysteyaal ku qaadeen gaari amni oo ilaalinayay shaqaalaha mashruuca waddada Mandera–Arabia–Lafey, sida ay werisay The Standard iyo warbaahin kale oo Kenya ah.

item.title: Hindiya: 3 shaqaale oo ku dhintay warshadda qaybaha iPhone ee Tata ee Hosur
item.description: Saddex shaqaale qandaraas ah ayaa ku dhintay warshadda Tata Electronics ee Hosur, gobolka Tamil Nadu, kaddib markii ay neefsadeen gaas intii ay baarayeen haan biyo-sifeyn, sida ay werisay Al Jazeera.

item.title: Isbaanish: Sarkaal booliis ah oo ku dhintay qarax boorso ka dhacay magaalada Oviedo
item.description: Sarkaal ka tirsan Booliska Qaranka Isbaanish ayaa ku dhintay, mid kalena si xun ayuu u dhaawacmay, kaddib markii boorso dhabarka la saarto ay ku qaraxday dhisme ku yaal magaalada Oviedo, sida ay werisay BBC iyo warbaahinta Isbaanish.

item.title: Uganda: Golaha Wasiirada oo ansixiyay 19 bilyan oo shilin oo loogu talagalay 1,841 ganacsade oo fatahaaddu saameysay
item.description: Golaha Wasiirada Uganda ayaa ansixiyay 18.9995 bilyan oo shilin oo gargaar ah oo la siinayo 1,841 ganacsade oo la xaqiijiyay kuwaas oo ganacsigoodu ku waxyeelloobay fatahaaddii Kampala ee October 2025, sida ay werisay Nile Post.

item.title: Franziska Liebhardt, oo dahab ku qaadatay Paralympics-kii Rio 2016, oo ku geeriyootay da'da 44
item.description: Ciyaartoyda Jarmalka Franziska Liebhardt, oo ku guuleysatay billad dahab ah oo tuurista culeyska ah iyo billad lacag ah oo boodka dheer ah Paralympics-kii Rio 2016, ayaa ku geeriyootay da'da 44, sida ay werisay kicker.

item.title: Mareykanka oo diyaarado ka raray saldhigga RAF Mildenhall ee Ingiriiska kaddib hanjabaad Iran
item.description: Ciidamada Mareykanka ayaa Isniintii diyaarado shidaal-ku-shubid ah ka raray saldhigga cirka ee RAF Mildenhall ee bariga England kaddib hanjabaad laga sheegay Iran, sida uu werinayo wargeyska The Wall Street Journal.

item.title: Kenya: Maxkamadda Heerka Sare oo 1-da December dhageysan doonta dacwad cusub oo ka dhan ah golaha wasiirada Ruto
item.description: Maxkamadda Heerka Sare ee Kenya ayaa degdeg u aqoonsatay codsi lagu doonayo in la hakiyo golaha wasiirada, iyadoo ururro bulsho ay sheegeen in Madaxweyne William Ruto uusan fulin amar maxkamadeed oo ku saabsan dib-u-dhiska golaha.

item.title: beIN Sports oo raalligelin bixisay kaddib hadal takoorid jinsi ah oo tebinta lagu maqlay oo ku saabsan Sabalenka
item.description: Telefishinka beIN Sports ayaa raalligelin bixiyay kaddib markii mid ka mid ah faallo-bixiyayaashiisa, oo u maleynayay inaan la tebinayn, hadal xun ka yiri Aryna Sabalenka ka hor ciyaarteedii WTA Finals, sida ay RMC Sport werisay.

item.title: Cilmi-baaris: qiiqa shidaalka dhulka ka baxa oo markii ugu horreysay tan iyo Covid hoos u dhacaya
item.description: Qiiqa kaarboonka ee ka dhasha gubashada saliidda, gaaska iyo dhuxusha ayaa la filayaa inuu sanadkan 2026 hoos u dhaco 0.4 boqolkiiba, sida ay sheegtay warbixinta sanadlaha ah ee Global Carbon Budget.

item.title: Golaha Amaanka ee QM oo maanta warbixin ka dhageysanaya xaaladda siyaasadeed iyo amni ee Koonfur Suudaan
item.description: Golaha Amaanka ee Qaramada Midoobay ayaa Talaadadan yeelanaya kulan furan oo looga hadlayo xaaladda siyaasadeed iyo amni ee Koonfur Suudaan, sida ay Eye Radio werisay.

item.title: Tartanka Behobia-San Sebastián: 853 orodyahan oo la reebay kaddib markii ay waqtigoodii ka hor bilaabeen
item.description: Qabanqaabiyayaasha tartanka orodka 20 kiilomitir ee Behobia-San Sebastián ee dalka Basque ayaa buriyay natiijooyinka 853 orodyahan oo ka bilaabay koox ka horreysa tii loo qoondeeyay, sida ay RMC Sport iyo Diario Vasco werisay.

item.title: Wadahadallada Ukraine, Ruushka iyo Mareykanka oo Abu Dhabi dib uga bilaabmay kaddib 9 bilood oo hakad ah
item.description: Wafuud ka socda Ukraine, Ruushka iyo Mareykanka ayaa Talaadadan Abu Dhabi ku yeelanaya wareeggii ugu horreeyay ee wadahadallo tan iyo February, iyadoo wakiillo Yurub ah ay magaalada kula kulmayaan dhinaca Ukraine, sida ay werisay Türkiye Today oo soo xigatay AFP.

item.title: Mbappé oo loo doortay ciyaaryahanka bisha October ee LaLiga, isagoo ka horreeyay Lamine Yamal
item.description: Weeraryahanka Real Madrid Kylian Mbappé ayaa LaLiga u doortay ciyaaryahanka ugu fiican bishii October kaddib markii uu 4 gool ku dhaliyay 3 kulan, sida ay werisay RMC Sport.

item.title: Trump: Weerar cusub oo lagu qaado Iran wuxuu noqon lahaa ku dhowaad shan jibbaar kii hore
item.description: Madaxweynaha Mareykanka Donald Trump ayaa Isniintii sheegay in weerar cusub oo lagu qaado Iran uu noqon lahaa qiyaastii shan jibbaar kii ugu horreeyay, balse uu dib u dhigayo codsi ka yimid Qatar, Sacuudiga iyo dalal kale oo Khaliijka ah, sida ay werisay Türkiye Today.

item.title: Ruto oo daah-furay waddo 1.3 bilyan oo shilin ah oo Bonchari, kuna dhawaaqay qorshe waddooyin 22 bilyan ah
item.description: Madaxweynaha Kenya William Ruto ayaa degmada Bonchari ka daah-furay mashruuc waddo oo ku kacaya 1.3 bilyan oo shilin, wuxuuna ku dhawaaqay 22 bilyan oo shilin oo loogu talagalay dhismaha iyo dayactirka waddooyinka gobollada Kisii iyo Nyamira, sida ay werisay Capital FM.

item.title: Qoraaga Ingiriiska M. John Harrison oo 81 jir ah ayaa ku guuleystay Abaalmarinta Booker
item.description: M. John Harrison ayaa noqday qofka ugu da'da weyn ee abid ku guuleysta Abaalmarinta Booker, isagoo buuggiisa "The End of Everything" ku helay abaalmarinta 2026 ee £50,000, sida ay Türkiye Today werisay.

item.title: Rubucda caalamka oo ku heshiisay inay fududeeyaan wada-hadallada doorashada Soomaaliya
item.description: Maraykanka, Britain, Turkiga iyo Midowga Yurub ayaa isku raacay inay fududeeyaan wada-hadallada doorashooyinka ee u dhexeeya dowladda federaalka iyo mucaaradka, kuwaas oo la qorsheeyay 14-ka ilaa 18-ka November, sida ay Hiiraan Online sheegtay.

item.title: Bunny Shaw oo ka mid ah shanta u tartamaysa Ciyaaryahanadda Sanadka ee BBC 2026
item.description: BBC ayaa furtay codbixinta Ciyaaryahanadda Kubadda Cagta Haweenka ee Sanadka 2026, iyadoo liiska kama dambaysta ah ay ku jiraan Temwa Chawinga, Ewa Pajor, Alexia Putellas, Alessia Russo iyo Khadija 'Bunny' Shaw.

item.title: Kenya oo si joogto ah u xiraysa safaaraddeeda Bern ee dalka Switzerland
item.description: Safaaradda Kenya ee Bern ayaa ogeysiisay in adeegyada qunsuliyadda ay joogsanayaan 30-ka November 2026, iyadoo Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda ay sheegtay in go'aanku qayb ka yahay dib-u-habeynta xafiisyada diblomaasiyadeed ee dalka, sida ay Capital FM werisay.

item.title: FIFPro World 11 ee ragga 2026: Harry Kane oo ka maqan, Messi-na markii 18aad ku jira
item.description: Ururka FIFPro ayaa shaaciyay kooxda ugu fiican adduunka ee ragga 2026, oo ay codeeyeen 19806 ciyaartoy; Harry Kane oo dhawaan ku guuleystay Ballon d'Or kuma jiro, halka Lionel Messi uu markii 18aad ku jiro, sida ay wariyeen FIFPro iyo RMC Sport.

item.title: Koonfur Suudaan: Cardinal Ameyu oo ugu baaqay hoggaamiyayaasha Suudaan iyo Koonfur Suudaan inay muwaadiniinta mudnaan siiyaan
item.description: Cardinal Stephen Ameyu Martin Mulla ayaa magaalada Torit ka sheegay in hoggaamiyayaasha labada dal ay danaha shacabka ka hormariyaan hammiga siyaasadeed, isagoo ku baaqay is-afgarad iyo wadahadal, sida ay werisay Radio Tamazuj.

item.title: Krakow: Madaxweyne Nawrocki iyo Ra'iisul Wasaare Tusk oo hoggaamiyay socod aamusan oo loogu talagalay dhibbanayaasha
item.description: Kumanaan qof ayaa habeenkii Isniinta ku socday bartamaha Krakow iyagoo xusaya dadkii lagu dilay rasaastii Sabtidii ka dhacday Fagaaraha Suuqa Weyn, waxaana hormuud ka ahaa Madaxweyne Karol Nawrocki iyo Ra'iisul Wasaare Donald Tusk, sida ay werisay BBC.

item.title: Tanzania: Qareennada Tundu Lissu oo sheegay in diyaarinta racfaanka xukunka 4 sano ay kala bar marayso
item.description: Qareennada guddoomiyaha xisbiga mucaaradka Chadema, Tundu Lissu, ayaa sheegay inay dhammeeyeen kala bar diyaarinta racfaanka xukunka 4 sano ee xabsi ah ee lagu riday dacwad kicin ah, sida ay werisay The Citizen.

item.title: NBA: Wembanyama oo 40 dhibcood dhaliyay, Spurs-na 9 guul oo isku xigta gaartay
item.description: San Antonio Spurs ayaa Isniintii Phoenix Suns kaga adkaatay 122-96, iyadoo Victor Wembanyama uu 25 daqiiqo gudahood ku dhaliyay 40 dhibcood, 11 rebound iyo 9 block, sida ay wariyeen RMC Sport iyo AP.

item.title: Madaxa canshuuraha Koonfur Suudaan: iskaanarro ayaa shaqaalaha kastamka Nimule ka dhigi kara 50
item.description: Guddoomiyaha Hay'adda Dakhliga Qaranka Koonfur Suudaan, Rizig Dominic Samuel, ayaa sheegay in iskaanarro casri ah oo la geeyo xadka Nimule ay shaqaalaha kastamka ka dhimi karaan in ka badan 600 ilaa ku dhawaad 50, sida uu Eye Radio soo wariyay.

item.title: Australia oo shaacisay xeerar adag oo amniga AI ah iyo hay'ad cusub oo kormeerta
item.description: Ra'iisul Wasaare Anthony Albanese ayaa ku dhawaaqay in shirkadaha AI ee ka shaqeeya Australia ay qasab ku noqon doonto inay soo sheegaan jebinta amniga, iyadoo la samaynayo hay'ad cusub oo kormeer ah, sida ay SBS iyo Sweden Herald soo wariyeen.

item.title: Faa'iidada ganacsiga Shiinaha oo dhaaftay 1 trillion oo doollar 10 bilood gudahood
item.description: Xogta kastamka Shiinaha ayaa muujisay in faa'iidada ganacsiga dalka ee Janaayo ilaa Oktoobar ay gaartay 1.04 trillion oo doollar, iyadoo dhoofinta ay kor u kacday baahida caalamiga ah ee qalabka AI, sida ay CNN iyo AFP soo wariyeen.
